summary: Validated the R$120 -> R$180 PIX valor bug fix on both backend and frontend. Backend endpoint /api/pix/generate correctly enforces the inscription's real valor as source of truth (5406180.00) even when the client sends valor=120. Frontend page /pagamento-pix.html correctly displays R$180,00 in the intended flow (with __valor=180 or with __valor missing -> fallback). Admin panel (/api/admin/inscriptions and /api/admin/dashboard/kpis) shows valor=180.0 and valor_total=180.0 for the seeded inscription CPF 23079653785. 8/8 pytest backend regression tests pass.

ui_bugs.issue: Display 'Valor' (#p-valor) is populated from sessionStorage.__valor without cross-checking the authoritative value returned by /api/pix/generate (res.data.valor). If sessionStorage has stale/wrong __valor (e.g. 120), the visible text shows 'R$ 120,00' while the generated PIX code correctly encodes 5406180.00 -> user-visible amount disagrees with actual PIX amount. In the intended candidate flow this does not occur (dados-inscricao.html writes __valor=180 from data-price), so the reported bug for real users is FIXED. Recommend making the backend response the single source of truth for the display too (setText('p-valor', fmtBRL(res.data.valor)) after fetch).

action_items: OPTIONAL (defense in depth): update /app/frontend/public/pagamento-pix.html so that after receiving /api/pix/generate response, it overwrites the displayed 'Valor' with res.data.valor: e.g. `setText('p-valor', fmtBRL(res.data.valor));` inside the success branch (around line 890). This eliminates the theoretical display/PIX-code mismatch if sessionStorage ever carries a wrong __valor. Not blocking for the reported bug — the intended candidate flow now works correctly.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug R$120 -> R$180 is fixed for the real candidate flow. Backend /api/pix/generate now uses insc.valor as source of truth and returns 5406180.00 even if client sends valor=120 (verified with pytest regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_pix_valor_fix.py). Admin panel shows 180 correctly. The only residual concern is that pagamento-pix.html paints #p-valor from sessionStorage.__valor and does not update it from the backend response — this is a display robustness issue, not the reported bug, and does not affect users in the normal flow (dados-inscricao.html writes __valor=180 from the vaga data-price='180.00').
rca of the issue: Original bug: pagamento-pix.html had hardcoded valor:120 and taxa:'R$ 120,00', so the visible amount and the PIX EMV field 54 both showed R$120 while the admin/database correctly held R$180. Fix applied by main agent: (1) pagamento-pix.html now reads storedValor from sessionStorage.__valor with fallback 180 (never 120 hardcoded); (2) backend /api/pix/generate at admin_routes.py:~1253 looks up the inscription by cpf and overrides the payload valor with insc.valor before building the BRCode. Verified via pytest (8/8 pass) + browser test on the live preview URL.
